title: qa(checklist): unblock 4 fixture-blocked items with the recipes the follow-up run #21845 proved, and re-point the clauses it found mis-asserted
body:
QA-source: #21845 (17.7 pre-release follow-up) · #21782 (re-run comment)

Follows #21797 (closed by #21811). Owning repo: this one (`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json`). Every entry is a checklist change only; the product defects found in the same run are carded separately (#21846–#21850, objectstack-ai/objectui#11650).

## Lift `blocked` and add the fixture note

1. **approvals.quorum-m-of-n** — fixture (runtime, admin API only, stock boot): bind a second committee position holder (`POST /api/v1/data/sys_user_position {user_id: <Ada>, position: "finance", organization_id}`) and, for 2-of-3, invite + sign up a third user bound to `legal`; **disable the competing per-group sign-off flow** for the process (`POST /api/v1/automation/showcase_expense_signoff/toggle {"enabled":false}`) — otherwise any ≥5000 report opens that flow's request and the quorum run fails `DUPLICATE_REQUEST`; open a **fresh** request (slates are fixed at open): draft report + a 6000 line + PATCH status submitted.
2. **approvals.sla-escalation** — fixture: a wall-clock offset shim loaded with `NODE_OPTIONS=--require <shim>` (wraps `Date`/`Date.now` with a file-read offset, sets `Date.prototype.constructor` to the proxy; timers untouched — no product logic changes); register one approval flow per action with `escalation {enabled:true, timeoutHours:1, action, notifySubmitter:true}` via `POST /api/v1/automation` (no writable package needed); advance +2h and wait for the 5-minute sweep (or restart for the boot sweep). Name the sweep interval and boot catch-up in the item.
3. **identity-auth.linked-accounts-social** — fixture: a local authorization-code + PKCE OIDC provider (discovery, authorize, token, userinfo, jwks) registered through the auth service's public config patch in a scratch app plugin (`applyConfigPatch({oidcProviders:[…]})`; `auth:configure` fires too early); the provider must be up before the first auth request. Step 2 must link through the authenticated `POST /api/v1/auth/link-social` and navigate to the returned URL. Nav label is "Linked Accounts" (Account app).
4. **records-forms.import-job-undo-cancel** — the stock console already satisfies the "import-job-capable client" gate at this pin; run objectui `e2e/import-console/import-console-undo.spec.ts` with `IMPORT_CONSOLE_LIVE=1` from a scratch copy whose goto path is `/_console/apps/{app}/{object}`; API half under `/api/v1/data/import/jobs` (create, progress, results, cancel, undo). `revertedAt` is absent, not null, until reverted.

## Re-point

5. **approvals.quorum-m-of-n · negative[0]** (assertion defect): require a non-privileged repeat actor; a platform/tenant admin override decision finalizes by design (#3424, recorded `via_override:true`).
6. **approvals.quorum-m-of-n · acceptance[2]**: the "reject edge" is not observable (end nodes log no step); assert "the run goes paused → completed and the request is rejected".
7. **approvals.quorum-m-of-n · acceptance[3]**: inbox tab is "My Pending" in the English console; the drawer subtitle "(2 of 3)" is static flow text — the tally is the "Approvals — x of y" line.
8. **cli.scaffold-first-run step 2 / cli.scaffold-console-first-paint step 1** (assertion defect): the scaffolder already installs with pnpm; a trailing `npm install` fails on that layout (17.6.0 and 17.7 alike). Drop the step, or use `pnpm install`, or scaffold with `--skip-install` before an npm install.
9. **cli.scaffold-first-run fixtures**: add a pre-release variant — pack the workspace to a local registry with no upstream for `@objectstack/*` and `create-objectstack`, run the repo's bin against it, prove the candidate via lockfile integrity; the published path only measures what is released. A4: "installed set" means unique skill names.
10. **cli.scaffold-console-first-paint · acceptance[3]**: a blank scaffold ships no app or action; point the action/nav half at `studio-authoring.first-run-loop` or state the limit.
11. **i18n.surface-matrix / i18n.studio-follows-app-locale steps**: "use the avatar-menu language switcher (it writes the user's locale); seeding browser storage alone is not a language switch" (the held fail on #21782 was this harness gap).
